nabhogatāyā latāyāḥ śākhāyāḥ patreṣu sthitena tena sarvā
ādhānādyaśvamedhāntāḥ

kā tvamiti praśnasyottaramuktvā
svāgamanaprayojanamāha - ya ityādinā

kṛcchraṃ prāṇasaṃkaṭaṃ saṃprāpya maraṇāveśa ātmaghātasaṃkalpastena
yāyinyā āgatayā tvayā naḥ asmatto yācitastena hetunā jñātā tattvajñaḥ

mayi pratyagātmani rūḍhiṃ vyutpattidārḍhyaṃ yathā dhiyā putra eti prāpnoti tathā
itihāsadṛṣṭāntādibhirabodhayaditi pūrvatrānvayaḥ
